edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender(), making the caller identity the root of all ownership checks
_msgSender() feeds the require in the onlyOwner modifier used as the access control gate
owner() result is compared against _msgSender() inside onlyOwner
owner() reads the _owner state variable
constructor derives the initial owner from _msgSender()
local msgSender is assigned and then written into _owner
constructor writes the deployer address into _owner granting privileged control
_msgSender() is stored into the local msgSender variable
onlyOwner restricts who may toggle distribution flags via EnableRedistroibutions
onlyOwner restricts who may set the _uni destination via Renounce
caller-supplied user parameter becomes the mapping key of the _enable flag write
enable parameter is the boolean value stored in the _enable mapping
unsafe write mutates the _enable state mapping that gates transfers
uni_ parameter is assigned directly into the privileged _uni state variable
unsafe write redirects _uni to an arbitrary attacker-chosen address
from parameter is used as the key in the require(_enable[from]) gate

amount parameter flows into the hook but is unused by the gating condition
